name: SDN PNM Publication History Flow
description: HTTP PNM-provenance flow (gateway loop G.3): a $HTQ HttpRequest enters on the http-request trigger, foundation/http-route discover emits the routing decision (pnm_history with peerId + in-wasm clamped limit [1,100] default 1 | not_found), hostcap/p2p-discovery pnm_history issues the policy-mediated p2p.pnm_history hostcall (the peer's stored signed $PNM publications, publisher-attributed by Ed25519 SIGNATURE on the host because the store's recorded peer id is only the gossip-delivering peer; short-circuited on not_found) and re-emits the decision, foundation/discovery-shape shape_pnm splices the signed $PNM frames VERBATIM (signatures intact) newest-first / encodes the bare-array json presentation with the signature_verified/attribution provenance fields and the shared FNV-1a etag / rewrites empty histories to not_found, and foundation/http-respond assembles the final $HTR envelope (200/304/404) delivered to the host-model egress sink. Bridge linkage: the only host crossing is the declared p2p_read hostcall.

triggers.description: One $HTQ HttpRequest envelope per invocation, pumped by the host at the flow ingress.

api.tagDescription: Peer and standards discovery served by the G.2/G.3 gateway flows (wasm; routing, format selection, limit clamping and ETag logic run inside the module; materials come from the policy-mediated p2p_read capability).

routes.summary: The peer's newest signed PNM publications (verifiable provenance)
routes.description: The signed Publish Notification Messages this peer PUBLISHED, newest first (default limit=1 = the newest publication). PROVENANCE, VERIFIABLY: the default encoding is the stored $PNM FlatBuffer frames VERBATIM — signatures intact — so a cold client can verify each one end-to-end: PNM.SIGNATURE is a hex Ed25519 signature (SIGNATURE_TYPE=Ed25519) over the payload "SDN-DPM-PNM\0" + FILE_ID + "\0" + CID, verified against the publisher's Ed25519 publication key — the peer-id identity key and/or the key_type=signing/ed25519 entry in the publisher's EPM KEYS (fetch it from GET /api/v1/peers/{peerId}). ATTRIBUTION HONESTY: the node's store records only the GOSSIP-DELIVERING peer id for each PNM, which is not necessarily the publisher; this surface therefore attributes by SIGNATURE — an entry belongs to {peerId} iff its signature verifies under that peer's publication key (attribution=signature, signature_verified=true). Only when the node cannot resolve any key for the peer does it fall back to the stored gossip attribution, honestly marked attribution=gossip, signature_verified=false. format=json: bare array of {publisher_peer_id, gossip_peer_id, standard, schema, FILE_ID, FILE_NAME, CID, PUBLISH_TIMESTAMP, SIGNATURE_TYPE, SIGNATURE, signature_verified, attribution, publisher_key|null, publisher_key_source|null} — the same records, presentation only; PNM schema fields carry SCHEMA-EXACT IDL names, synthesized provenance/API fields stay lowercase snake_case (hard rule json-schema-capitalization-rule).

params.name: peerId
params.description: libp2p peer ID of the PUBLISHING peer (e.g. 16Uiu2HAm…).

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of newest publications to return. Default 1 (the newest). Clamped in-wasm to [1, 100].

params.name: format
params.description: Response encoding: flatbuffer = aligned size-prefixed $PNM FlatBuffer stream (default, signature-verifiable verbatim frames), json = bare JSON array of publication records.

200.description: Signed publication stream, newest first. Metadata rides in headers on BOTH encodings: X-SDN-Record-Count and a content-derived ETag shared across encodings.

application/vnd.sdn.flatbuffers.stream.description: Aligned size-prefixed $PNM FlatBuffer frames, VERBATIM as stored (Ed25519 signatures intact), newest first.

application/json.description: Bare top-level JSON array of publication records with provenance fields (format=json).

304.description: Not modified (If-None-Match matched the stream ETag). Empty body, ETag header repeated.

404.description: Peer unknown to this node, or no signed PNM publications attributable to it are stored here.
